title: Releasing Ice Cream Parlor
content: A few years ago I worked on a prototype for an ice cream serving game.
Because I found it so fun and addicting, I picked it back up and released it on my site!

title: Check out Plompy
content: I've been making lots of custom models for Minecraft using Blockbench in my own time and for clients.
Plompy is my first custom mob that works using EMF and ETF and based off a real bat-eared fox

title: My new Tool: BruteCraft
content: BruteCraft is a helpful tool for WynnCraft that helps with a pretty complicated system in the game: Crafting.
In WynnCraft, you can combine hundreds of different items to create gear and consumables with purposes ranging from combat, movement, survivability and more.
BruteCraft helps you figure out the best combination of items to yield the best result possible using a evolutionary algorithm.

title: My new App: BlanketJS
content: Listen to ambient sounds, mix them together and adjust their volumes.
Set it and forget it, this will increase your productivity, as it does mine.

title: A fresh coat of paint
content: Warze.org just got a new landing page, you're seeing it right now!
This is more mobile friendly and improves SEO while simultaneously being flashy.

title: My new Puzzle Game: Lights on! 2
content: "Lights On! 2" is a sequel project I've made in just 3 days. All you have to do is place light bulbs throughout the room and make sure all of it is illuminated.

title: Talk with AI on discord
content: I created a discord bot that interfaces with the Ollama API, letting you host LLMs on your own PC.

title: My new Platformer Game: Ball 2
content: Ball 2 is a pixel perfect recreation of a really old computer game from my childhood (Released ~2000).
Jump through 30 levels or create your own with the level editor!
Try out Ball 2 now, the code is on Gitea.

title: Showing off an animated 3D book in CSS and JS
content: Here's a small project that I recorded myself creating. It's an animated book using beautiful CSS animations.

title: I rewrote WartOS in VueJS
content: It now features a more streamlined design with more icons, a search system and rich animations.

title: My new Puzzle Game: Lights on
content: A remake of a popular puzzle game with more fleshed out puzzle design.
Can you solve all 14 levels? Turn all the lights on, it shouldn't be that hard... right?
With each click, adjacent lamps toggle and you have to fiddle around to find the right pattern.

title: Practice Flags using my new game
content: FlagQuiz is a game where you have to guess the flag of a country. It's a fun way to learn flags and their countries across the world.

title: Create a Discord status out of emojis
content: A VueJS rewrite of a similar project I made in 2021.
A widely used tool shared across the social media platform Discord to create pixel art out of emoji and use it in messages, statuses, about me or wherever else.

title: I enhanced JollyWorld customization
content: By developing a modding tool for JollyWorld, I allowed players to easily create their own custom characters.
It also shows a wide variety of community-created mods that can be downloaded with just a click. Most of which have amassed 10,000+ downloads.
